column_semantics: The schedule has one Spread Above Index column and one Interest Rate column, but for PIK positions the printed text decomposes each into a cash component plus a separate PIK component. The numeric rate before 'Cash' is the cash leg only; the PIK percentage is quoted separately and is additive/on top. Pure PIK preferred equity rows print the PIK rate alone as PIK.

rationale: The filing does not present PIK as a parenthetical included in an all-in coupon. Instead, actual schedule rows label the cash rate and PIK rate separately within the printed Spread Above Index and Interest Rate cells, e.g. '11.50 % Cash + 0.16 % PIK' and '11.18 % Cash + 2.00 % PIK'. That means the stated cash percentage excludes PIK, and PIK is quoted separately on top.
